method: Change-detection sweep against issuer pages (chase.com, americanexpress.com, capitalone.com, delta.com, marriott.com, hilton.com, united.com, hyatt.com, ihg.com, southwest.com, thecenturionlounge.com, instacart.com Chase co-brand pages, Chase/DoorDash co-brand terms), run by four parallel per-issuer agents against the 2026-08-10 baseline. NO issuer-side benefit change found on any of the 17 cards for the SIXTH consecutive pass; all 17 annual fees re-confirmed unchanged from issuer page headers. What changed is our record, not the products: +14 benefits (174 -> 188). HEADLINE: instacart.com/p/chase-cobrands rendered for the first time after being JS-gated on every prior attempt, and it contradicts us on three cards -- it names World of Hyatt, World of Hyatt Business and Southwest Performance Business as enrollment-eligible, though Chase's own product pages for those three market no Instacart benefit. Added all three (+$360/yr) on the enrollment page's authority, flagged 'verify at enrollment', because enrolling is free and reversible while leaving them unrecorded forfeits $10/month each. SECOND MATERIAL FIX: United Quest's Instacart credit was recorded as requiring no enrollment -- it does, and at a DIFFERENT url (instacart.com/p/chase-united, window 3/23/25-12/31/27). That error was silently costing $15/month. Other additions: Southwest Priority 5X Lyft through 12/31/27; Reserve Travel Designers on both Reserves; CSP Points Boost 1.5x; Business Gold's Hotel Collection $100 and cell-phone protection; Delta Reserve Business Global Dining Access and 4 Sky Club guest passes; Aspire Return Protection and Global Dining Access; Venture X Business rental-car coverage (with the condition that 'primary' applies only to business-purpose or foreign rentals). Sourcing upgrades: four Aspire items (resort credit, flight credit, National Emerald, earn rates) and the Business Platinum Indeed credit moved off blog sources onto Amex/Hilton pages -- only 2 secondary-sourced items remain. Sourcing corrections: the Bonvoy 35k cap cites the marriott.com card page (the string '35,000' appears zero times in Marriott's program terms) and the 25k top-off is section 3.3.c.i; the Southwest Performance Business DoorDash source moved off doordash.com onto Chase's terms page; IHG United TravelBank registration is at ihg.com/united through your IHG account, NOT a MileagePlus registration. Sourcing downgrades: the Delta Stays 'calendar year' reset is not issuer-supported and is now flagged unknown; the Exclusive Tables 404-restaurant count and 60-day grace period are not on any issuer page; Hyatt's early-award-access wording names the personal card only, so applying it to the business card is our inference. Re-confirmed negative: United Quest still has no DoorDash (Chase's '$850+' still itemises to $860 without it); American Airlines is still NOT a Capital One transfer partner (page still dated 2026-01-29, 18 airlines + 4 hotels -- refuted a fifth time); Delta Reserve Business still has no CLEAR and no airline-fee credit, and its companion certificate still includes Premium Select per Delta's governing T&C despite marketing copy omitting it; Hilton Aspire still has no lounge access and no Global Entry credit; Southwest's retired $75 credit and upgraded boardings are still gone; the CSR Marriott Gold fast-track wording is character-for-character unchanged (register AND complete 3 nights inside Jul 1 - Sep 30). Method note: Chase's JS-gated IHG Business and Hyatt Business perk pages can be bypassed via their AEM disclosure fragments (chase.com/content/chase-ux/.../disclaimer.html), which serve full verbatim terms over plain HTTP.
